Induction of labor with sequential double-balloon catheter and oral misoprostol
induction of labour with a double-balloon catheter and sequential oral misoprostol
Induction of labor with oral misoprostol alone
outcome: Rate of vaginal delivery within 24 and 48 hours
cohort: 400 pregnant women with BMI higher than 35 kg/m2 undergoing labor induction at term
finding: In obese women, induction of labor with sequential use of a double-balloon catheter and oral misoprostol was associated with a significantly lower cesarean section rate compared to oral misoprostol alone, particularly in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Induction of labor with sequential use of a double-balloon catheter and oral misoprostol was associated with a significantly lower cesarean section rate compared to oral misoprostol alone.
